title: C: Bit Manipulation
description: Use bitwise operators (&, |, ^, <<, >>) to manipulate individual bits of integers.

steps.title: Set, Clear, Toggle Bits
steps.description: Write functions `int set_bit(int n, int pos)`, `int clear_bit(int n, int pos)`, `int toggle_bit(int n, int pos)`, and `int get_bit(int n, int pos)` to manipulate the bit at position `pos`. Test with n=0b1010 (10), pos=0 and pos=3.

verification.failureMessage: Test set, clear, toggle, and get bit operations
